name: Valganciclovir
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Not recommended unless benefit outweighs risk.
Monitor blood counts and kidney function.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other myelosuppressive or nephrotoxic drugs (dapsone, doxorubicin, flucytosine, hydroxyurea, pentamidine, tacrolimus, co-trimoxazole, vinca alkaloids, zidovudine)
key_interactions.action: Use only if the benefit outweighs the risk.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Renally excreted drugs in kidney impairment
key_interactions.action: Monitor closely for toxicity of both.
